description: This source file defines the CMapInfo helper class within the PdfSharp.Fonts namespace, which manages character-to-glyph mappings for fonts in a PDF processing library.

classes.name: CMapInfo
classes.description: Helper class that determines the characters used in a particular font, managing mappings between Unicode code points and glyph indices.

methods.name: CMapInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the character map with a font descriptor.

methods.name: AddChars
methods.description: Adds character-to-glyph mappings based on an array of CodePointGlyphIndexPair.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a character is in the character-to-glyph map.

methods.name: GetGlyphIndices
methods.description: Returns a sorted array of glyph indices used in the font.
